risks: Published new-file ownership overlaps WP-51 command modules and WP-52 compose/env/livekit; root wave0 integration may create/change these during preflight. Hash-bound evidence must be refreshed before patches.
RequestContext and current gateway owner/workspace logic are not shared authenticated operator ACL; adding a restore handler alone leaves authority and legacy-writer gaps.
String restore responseSchema status versus existing Rox2CanonicalResult triad and absent normative transport error codes need accepted shared mapping, not silent type casts or success aliases.
Receipt/job keys versus service_config entity names and two proposed migration identifiers require selected schema/migrator clarification; never recreate common command/entity/outbox tables.

Native deletion is intentionally unavailable. Hosted retention does not prove local WP-35 deletion; local adapters must return real receipts or explicit unavailable state, with external copies retained honestly.
Exactly-one notification acceptance introduces a behavior dependency on WP-07 absent from explicit WP-47 array; WP-04 outbox cannot substitute for that consumer.

Restore of stale leases/policy snapshots or object inventory without generation fencing can resurrect access, private snippets or duplicate external effects. Unknown remote effects must reconcile, never blind resend.
Deleting object alone is insufficient: preview/transcript/summary/search/mentions/asset links and authorized audit retention need complete canonical-copy manifest and legal-hold policy.

Retention SLA, hold authority, retry limits, alert thresholds and backup consistency model are not concretely resolved by inspected code/spec. Do not invent measured values or reuse search budget as all-purpose deletion SLA.

TURN/TLS/SFU/egress/STT/object and JMAP provider operations require genuine isolated connectivity and secret-reference injection; packet generic providerSandbox wording cannot waive explicit real JMAP/audio/video DoD.
Native server Dockerfile is not shared-service or media-worker deployment. A new Dockerfile without accepted worker executable would be incomplete scaffolding.
Logs/metrics, provider exceptions, backup shell tracing and signed URLs can leak PRIVATE_WP-47 or secrets; capture negative paths as well as successful requests.
